text:
maria: Heads up — Cost Explorer shows ~22% drop in RI/SavingsPlan coverage for p4d in us-west-2 starting last Friday. I'm seeing a bunch of instances that look like they should be covered but aren't being matched. Anyone else seeing weird reservation hits?

kevin: I saw the alert from infra-bot this morning about 'unapplied reservations'. Didn't dig in yet. Do we have a list of affected instance ids or accounts? :thinking_face:

maria: Yep. pulling a short query from our CUR export (BigQuery). dropping the sample here: 
```sql
SELECT instance_id, product_family, account_id, tags.environment, sum(line_item_unblended_cost) AS cost
FROM `company_billing.aws_cur.ec2_usage`
WHERE product_family LIKE '%p4d%'
  AND usage_start_time >= TIMESTAMP_SUB(CURRENT_TIMESTAMP(), INTERVAL 7 DAY)
GROUP BY instance_id, product_family, account_id, tags.environment
ORDER BY cost DESC
LIMIT 50;
```
Found ~120 instances where account_id != reservation_account and tags.environment is null or 'prod ' (trailing space).

aj: trailing space in tag value. oof. That explains a good chunk. Our billing allocation job normalizes tags before skyline, but the reservation reconciliation script matches against account-level reservations that assume canonical tag values.

sam-finance: If instances are getting billed to the wrong cost center because of tag noise, our reported coverage per-team will be off and we might miss renewals. Do we have a quick fix? Can we backfill tags or remap in the billing view?

kevin: Quick mitigation: re-tag the live instances with canonical values for 'environment' and 'service-team' where we can. For the ones we can't touch (autoscaling groups still firing), update the billing view mapping to treat 'prod ' == 'prod' and treat null as 'unknown-prod' so the reservation allocation goes to the right account temporarily.

maria: I'll run a safe re-tag for the top 30 instances (lowest risk). Script I'm planning to run: 
```bash
aws ec2 create-tags --resources $(cat affected_ids.txt) --tags Key=environment,Value=prod --region us-west-2 --profile infra-write
```
I'll dry-run on a small batch first.

infra-bot: automated-audit: found 117 reservations with zero matched instances in us-west-2 (p4d family) in the last 7d. Linked ticket: #INC-4921. :robot_face:

aj: Also let's add a normalization step to the tagger in the autoscale launch template. Most of these look like user errors from the old terraform module (module/ec2:env defaulting to "prod "). I'll open a PR to sanitize and add an allowlist so spaces get trimmed on create.

sam-finance: Can we get an interim report on how much $$ is impacted if we don't fix this until renewal? Need numbers for the renewal decision meeting Thursday.

kevin: I'll run a delta calc: 7d unallocated usage * hourly reservation rate estimate => ballpark additional on-demand spend. Expecting ~$28k/week if fully unreserved. Will post numbers in this thread by EOD.

maria: Action items: 1) run safe re-tag on top 30 instances (maria) 2) PR normalization in autoscale templates (aj) 3) billing view mapping tweak (kevin + finance) 4) run full reconciliation and generate spreadsheet of 'ghost reservations' vs candidate instances (kevin) 5) follow-up weekly audit job to run and notify (infra-bot)

kevin: assigned myself and @aj to the recon spreadsheet. Will drop a CSV to #eng-infra-reports and ping finance after the delta calc.

aj: PR opened: https://git.company/repo/infra/+/1234 — includes tag trim + unit tests. Please review.

maria: ran re-tag dry-run on 5 hosts — no restarts, tags updated. Proceeding with the top 30 now. Will report when done. :white_check_mark:

infra-bot: automated-audit: re-run complete. Unapplied reservation count in us-west-2 (p4d) dropped from 117 -> 46 after tag fix. Next scheduled sweep: 2026-03-21T06:00Z.

sam-finance: Thanks — that reduction helps. Can we surface the remaining 46 in the renewal packet with probable cause notes (AZ specificity, account mismatch, or legacy RI scope)? I need that to recommend whether to renew the set or shift capacity.

kevin: Will attach the CSV and include a short 'probable cause' column. Tentative recommendation: hold on new commitments until we clear the remaining ~40 and run one more full-week audit. If remaining are true seat gaps, we'll propose a phased renewal.

maria: will close the loop once re-tagging completes and confirm no regressions from ASG. If anything sneaks back, infra-bot should alert.

kevin: posted CSV: https://storage.company/billing/recon/1768456789-ghosts.csv

aj: LGTM on the PR, merging now. Will follow up with a small migration runbook to roll the template to prod safely.

maria: great teamwork — thanks all. :pray:
